# DP-203T00: Data Engineering on Microsoft Azure — Training & Certification Guide

The [DP-203T00: Data Engineering on Microsoft Azure](https://www.koenig-solutions.com/microsoft-implementing-azure-data-solutions-training?utm_source=github&utm_medium=backlink&utm_campaign=github-publisher) delivers hands-on training for building robust data solutions on Azure. Participants learn to design storage architectures, develop batch and stream processing pipelines, secure data assets, and optimize performance. Aimed at data professionals transitioning to cloud-native environments, this course addresses the growing need for scalable data engineering amid exploding data volumes and real-time analytics demands in enterprise IT.

## Why This Certification Matters
With Azure's dominance in cloud data platforms, DP-203T00: Data Engineering on Microsoft Azure certification validates expertise in demand across industries like finance, healthcare, and retail. Data engineers, analytics developers, and cloud architects gain a competitive edge, unlocking roles with salaries averaging 20-30% higher and faster career progression in big data ecosystems.

## What You Will Learn
- Design and implement incremental data loads into Azure Synapse Analytics and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.
- Develop batch processing solutions using Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory mapping data flows.
- Build real-time streaming pipelines with Azure Stream Analytics, Event Hubs, and Kafka on Azure HDInsight.
- Implement data security features including Azure Key Vault, role-based access control, and data masking.
- Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data solutions with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and cost management tools.

## Who Should Attend
Data engineers, cloud data architects, and Azure developers with 1-2 years of data processing experience. Suited for IT professionals managing ETL workflows or analytics pipelines seeking to specialize in Azure data engineering.
